title: CaseManifest
description: Descriptive manifest of one materialised case: opaque id, dataset, data span, present sources, services, raw inputs, adapter and scrub counts (03 §2.1). Written by Infralume at pipeline step 0.

case_id.description: Opaque case id: first 12 hex of SHA-256 of the adapter's canonical case key (01 §3.2).

dataset.description: Dataset name, e.g. synth, re1-ob, re2-ob, re2-ss, re2-tt, re3-ob, nezha-ob, fse26-tt, veyllab-ob, veyllab-otel, live.

system.description: Benchmark system of the case, from the adapter.

t_alert_hint_ns.description: Alert hint in ns: the dataset's published injection time (oracle protocol) or the trigger time (live protocol); null under the detected protocol or when nothing is published. Only core's alert step reads it. Not checked against the data span here (a hint outside it is written unchanged).

hint_source.description: Origin of t_alert_hint_ns; none if and only if t_alert_hint_ns is null (enforced by the if/then/else below).

data_start_ns.description: Minimum timestamp in ns over all non-dropped sources, span start_ns/end_ns and overlay events included (01 §3.8). data_start_ns <= data_end_ns is a writer cross-field check.

data_end_ns.description: Maximum timestamp in ns over all non-dropped sources, span start_ns/end_ns and overlay events included (01 §3.8).

sources.description: Which telemetry sources are present; a dropped or absent source is false and its table has zero rows.

services.description: Sorted (UTF-8 byte order) union of normalised services in metrics, logs and spans; event-only entities excluded. May be empty (e.g. an events-only case).

inputs.description: One entry per raw file that contributed to a non-empty emitted table, plus overlay/events.parquet when an overlay is used (01 §3.8); sorted by name. Empty for synth.

name.description: Adapter name as registered under the veyltrace.adapters entry-point group, e.g. rcaeval, nezha, veyllab, otlp_live, synth.

version.description: Per-adapter revision string (e.g. "1"), not the package version.

dropped_rows.description: Number of rows dropped: deny-listed service rows, drop_containers rows and chaos events (Infralume documents the rule).

CaseManifestInput.title: CaseManifestInput
CaseManifestInput.description: One raw input file of the case.

name.description: Relative name <source>/<basename>, e.g. traces/traces.parquet; never contains the original folder name.
